title: Bone Crack
blurb: The bone crack — a crisp skeletal crunch that makes entire rooms wince. It's the sound for stretches that go too well, falls that land wrong, and any physical event the viewer should feel personally. Sound designers know: the crack sells the injury. Deploy for sympathetic pain, chiropractic content, and full-body cringe.
origin: A crisp cartilage-and-bone crunch for maximum wince.
